what_happened: Seven compiled probes (lean_run_code) closed every semantic risk in the AA soundness route before planning: time-free state-locality one-liner, PlusTruth next_iff_succ, cone-history one-step edge, the inr-anchoring induction with list-length, the family freshness congruence, the AA cone model with its two reading lemmas, and the full aa_expand step identity restated over WorldHistory (coneFrame F). All sorry-free.

omega cannot see linear arithmetic over the duration type up-intOrder (not syntactically Int), which blocks the archived probe's 'obtain (k, rfl) : exists k : Nat, s = t + k := (…, by omega)' idiom. Replacement found and compiled: Int.toNat_of_nonneg plus sub_nonneg plus abel, no omega. Also: coneFrame_taskRel does not rewrite against a goal phrased with (coneFrame F).toTaskFrame.TaskRel; a 'have' at FrameOver.TaskRel first is needed.

The plan's ten Lean Challenge Statements were compiled with 'lake env lean' during the planning dispatch itself (exit 0, only 'declaration uses sorry' diagnostics), so every pinned signature is a measured fact rather than an authoring-time assertion. The research probe supplied seven of them verbatim; the three new ones (aaStep/aaExcl/aaAnte) and the three headline signatures were drafted and checked in one round.

validate-artifact.sh's 'Files to modify' comma-joined-path warning fires on backtick-delimited DECLARATION NAMES in an entry's free-text annotation (e.g. '- `Foo.lean` - aaRun, aaState, aaState_step' written with backticks), not only on a genuine second path. Two phases warned; fixed by writing declaration names unbackticked in those annotations. Worth knowing: the lint cannot distinguish a path from any other backticked token on the line.
